// Prepare Google Ads API queries for the past 7 days
const accountId = $input.item.json.account_id;
const campaignIds = $input.item.json.campaign_ids;

// Calculate date range (last 7 days)
const endDate = new Date();
const startDate = new Date();
startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - 7);

const formatDate = (date) => {
  return date.toISOString().split('T')[0].replace(/-/g, '');
};

const dateRange = {
  start: formatDate(startDate),
  end: formatDate(endDate)
};

// Campaign Performance Query
const campaignQuery = `
  SELECT 
    campaign.id,
    campaign.name,
    campaign.status,
    metrics.impressions,
    metrics.clicks,
    metrics.conversions,
    metrics.cost_micros,
    metrics.ctr,
    metrics.average_cpc,
    metrics.cost_per_conversion
  FROM campaign
  WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '${dateRange.start}' AND '${dateRange.end}'
    AND campaign.id IN (${campaignIds.join(',')})
  ORDER BY metrics.cost_micros DESC
`;

// Keyword Performance Query
const keywordQuery = `
  SELECT
    campaign.id,
    campaign.name,
    ad_group.id,
    ad_group.name,
    ad_group_criterion.keyword.text,
    ad_group_criterion.keyword.match_type,
    metrics.impressions,
    metrics.clicks,
    metrics.conversions,
    metrics.cost_micros,
    metrics.ctr,
    metrics.cost_per_conversion
  FROM keyword_view
  WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '${dateRange.start}' AND '${dateRange.end}'
    AND campaign.id IN (${campaignIds.join(',')})
    AND ad_group_criterion.status = 'ENABLED'
  ORDER BY metrics.cost_micros DESC
`;

// Ad Performance Query
const adQuery = `
  SELECT
    campaign.id,
    campaign.name,
    ad_group.id,
    ad_group.name,
    ad_group_ad.ad.id,
    ad_group_ad.ad.type,
    metrics.impressions,
    metrics.clicks,
    metrics.conversions,
    metrics.cost_micros,
    metrics.ctr,
    metrics.cost_per_conversion
  FROM ad_group_ad
  WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '${dateRange.start}' AND '${dateRange.end}'
    AND campaign.id IN (${campaignIds.join(',')})
    AND ad_group_ad.status = 'ENABLED'
  ORDER BY metrics.cost_micros DESC
`;

// Search Terms Query (for wasted spend analysis)
const searchTermsQuery = `
  SELECT
    campaign.id,
    segments.search_term_match_type,
    search_term_view.search_term,
    metrics.impressions,
    metrics.clicks,
    metrics.conversions,
    metrics.cost_micros,
    metrics.ctr
  FROM search_term_view
  WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '${dateRange.start}' AND '${dateRange.end}'
    AND campaign.id IN (${campaignIds.join(',')})
  ORDER BY metrics.cost_micros DESC
  LIMIT 200
`;

return {
  json: {
    account_id: accountId,
    account_name: $input.item.json.account_name,
    target_cpl: $input.item.json.target_cpl,
    weekly_budget: $input.item.json.weekly_budget,
    manager_id: $input.item.json.manager_id,
    date_range: dateRange,
    queries: {
      campaign: campaignQuery,
      keyword: keywordQuery,
      ad: adQuery,
      search_terms: searchTermsQuery
    }
  }
};
